caption: Reddi Agent Protocol is a marketplace on Solana where agents pay for AI services from a Budget. You lock money once, give your agent a key, and every call it pays for comes back with a receipt.
tts: Reddi Agent Protocol is a marketplace on Solana, where agents pay for A I services from a Budget. You lock money once, give your agent a key, and every call it pays for comes back with a receipt.

caption: The key already has limits on chain. It can reserve and close. It can't withdraw, and it can't pay anyone who hasn't joined. What it can't tell you is who is behind the agent, or whether the job matches what its owner signed off on. That's your side of things.
tts: The key already has limits on chain. It can reserve, and close. It can't withdraw, and it can't pay anyone who hasn't joined. What it can't tell you is who is behind the agent, or whether the job matches what its owner signed off on. That's your side of things.

caption: So in the sandbox, before the agent reserves a cent, it asks Awareland two questions. Who runs this agent? And does the key match the mandate: five dollars at most, seventy-two hours, joined providers only? Awareland says pass.

caption: Then the agent gets on with the job. Tolca checks each provider's payout wallet first, and every call lands on a receipt chained to the one before it.
tts: Then the agent gets on with the job. Tolca checks each provider's payout wallet first, and every call lands on a receipt, chained to the one before it.

caption: The Budget closes and a 24-hour dispute window runs. Each provider is paid what its receipts add up to, and the rest goes back to the buyer.
tts: The Budget closes, and a twenty four hour dispute window runs. Each provider is paid what its receipts add up to, and the rest goes back to the buyer.

caption: In the demo the Awareland check is simulated, and free, because I didn't want to guess your price. I'd love to make it real: a paid check any agent can run from its Budget, or the trust layer behind our registry. Good luck closing the raise. Let's find a time to talk.
